headline: Tooling is 12 primitives; only 1 has its cost measured
brief: The team asked whether to adopt a million community 'skills'. A skill is one of twelve kinds of agent tooling, and each kind is judged by different tests. We built the map: every kind, the real tests that exist for it, and whether anyone checks what it COSTS to plug in. Almost nobody does — and cost is exactly what 'bloated' means.
